ctx.x: Just improvising. And then the river boats, you see, I heard -- I grew up listening to all the bands on the riverboats, like I first heard Bix Beiderbecke and Frankie Trumbauer and Ray Ludwig and all these fellas out of St. Louis, cause at that time, in well -- say 1908, by 1918, around
there, St. Louis was really the hub of jazz, more than people really give credit for.
